visualReview.finding: Seven module screenshots visually inspected: scoped media rendered, readable public English copy, no internal implementation instructions, no desktop overflow. Guest agent and batch forms show selected brief and correct scene context.

notes: 74 local controls were exercised with pointer and sampled keyboard activation. Dialog checks cover accessible naming, focus containment, Escape focus return, and visible close control.
20 distinct module/CTA destinations were clicked from restored homepage selections, using only anonymous read-only guest navigation.

Aspect is visibly selected in all applicable image/video ratio controls. Agent/Batch flows have no initial ratio control; query preservation is verified, persistence after saving is outside authorization.
No upload, save, task, generation, payment or credit action was performed. Historical publications/snapshots were not accessed or activated.
Relational source ownership and derived revision are verified by the release coordinator; this independent test establishes public browser readback only.
